jobs.title: Regional Sales Specialist — Dental & Aesthetics
jobs.summary: Develop dental and aesthetics accounts across Malaysia and Singapore, with focus on clinic engagement, product demonstrations and revenue growth.
jobs.description: This role supports Curative's regional dental and aesthetics portfolio, including imaging systems, professional skincare, injection-support products and clinic technologies. The role is suitable for a commercially driven candidate who can build relationships with clinics, arrange demonstrations, follow up quotations and coordinate with internal clinical and marketing teams.
requirements: Experience in medical, dental, aesthetics, pharmaceutical or healthcare sales
Able to manage clinic visits, demonstrations, quotations and follow-up independently
Good communication skills in English; Mandarin or Bahasa Malaysia is an advantage
Comfortable travelling for customer visits, training and regional events
benefits: Regional exposure across Curative's healthcare portfolio

jobs.title: Senior Clinical Sales Specialist — Ophthalmology
jobs.summary: Support ophthalmology customers across IOLs, cataract surgery consumables, surgical instruments and clinical product adoption.
jobs.description: This role works with eye clinics, hospitals and surgical teams to support Curative's ophthalmology portfolio. Responsibilities include account development, product education, operating theatre support coordination, stock planning and follow-up with doctors, nurses and procurement teams.
requirements: Experience in ophthalmology, medical device sales, clinical applications or operating theatre support
Strong follow-up discipline with doctors, nurses, purchasing teams and internal operations
Able to learn technical product details and communicate them clearly
Singapore healthcare or medical device market experience is preferred

jobs.title: Regional Clinical Application Specialist — Dental & Aesthetics
jobs.summary: Support Curative's dental and aesthetics portfolio across Malaysia and Singapore through product demonstrations, clinical training, installation support and post-sales follow-up.
jobs.description: Based in Kuala Lumpur with regular travel across Malaysia and to Singapore, this role provides clinical application support for Curative's dental and aesthetics equipment — including facial and intraoral scanning, digital dentistry workflows, treatment planning and aesthetic imaging systems. You'll work closely with the sales team, healthcare professionals and international suppliers to conduct demonstrations, deliver training, support installations and onboarding, and provide ongoing application guidance to clinics and hospitals. The role also supports customer evaluations, workshops, exhibitions and the development of reference sites and clinical case studies, reporting to the Regional Business Head.
requirements: Diploma or degree in dentistry, dental technology, nursing, biomedical science, medical technology or a related allied health field
2–5 years' experience in clinical applications, dental equipment, digital dentistry, aesthetic devices or medical device/healthcare technology
Experience conducting product demonstrations and customer training is preferred
Comfortable communicating clinical and technical information to dentists, doctors, nurses and clinic staff
Good spoken and written English; proficiency in Bahasa Malaysia required, other regional languages an advantage
Based in Kuala Lumpur or the Klang Valley, with a valid driving licence and own transport
Willing and able to travel frequently, and to work independently across multiple customer accounts
benefits: Regional exposure across Curative's dental and aesthetics portfolio
Close collaboration with international suppliers and manufacturers
Transport and mobile allowance, plus travel expense reimbursement
Performance incentive and annual bonus based on individual and company performance
